**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 22 (¶¶ p0082–p0084) is the only audit right binding us, and it already matches our preferred position on every parameter:

| Parameter | Playbook preferred | Document |
|---|---|---|
| Frequency | Once / 12 months | "no more than once in any twelve-month period" (22.1) |
| Notice | 30 days' written | "at least thirty days' prior written notice" (22.1) |
| Timing/disruption | Business hours | "during normal business hours... does not unreasonably disrupt Customer" (22.1) |
| Location/auditor | Off-site, independent auditor under NDA | "off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality" (22.1) |
| Cost | Vendor's cost unless underpayment > 5% | "Vendor bears audit costs unless the audit establishes an underpayment exceeding five percent" (22.2) |
| System access | None | "Vendor and its auditor may not access Customer systems directly, Customer Data unrelated to usage, privileged material, or another supplier's confidential information" (22.2) |

I also confirmed there are no parallel inspection, verification, monitoring or remote-access rights elsewhere in the agreement (§ 23 "Records and Customer Assurance" is a heading only, with no operative text). Section 22.3 adds further protections in our favour — audit findings are Customer Confidential Information usable only to enforce the Agreement, Vendor must give us the final report, and payment of a shortfall resolves the audited quantity issue absent fraud.
